question:
Which of the following is a plant tissue?

I. Meristematic tissue

II. Permanent tissue
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A tissue is a group of cells having a common origin and usually performing a common function.
 
• A plant is made up of different kinds of tissues.
 
• Tissues are classified into two main groups- 
 
 
• Meristematic Tissue- Cells have a capacity for division.
 
• Permanent Tissue- Cells have no capacity for division.
